profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, trading under ticker DLR and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001297996. Its website describes the company as delivering what it calls the world's largest data center platform, offering data center services, colocation, connectivity, and cloud services across a global ecosystem. The company says its facilities support deployments from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows.

On AI, the company's site states that inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional infrastructure to their limits, and that AI is exposing infrastructure gaps. It promotes a 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, reporting that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint and that enterprises are moving from AI strategy to execution.

Texas legal records list 126 matters involving Digital Realty.
